predict.question: Before a job ships, it passes three checkpoints, and each one retains 95% of the complete jobs that reach it. What percentage of jobs is still complete after all three?

exploreHint: Run both cases; compare the changed input.
bookIdea: Checklists help teams remember critical steps when routine competence is not enough.
modelBoundary: Retaining 90% at each checkpoint leaves {A}%; retaining 95% leaves {B}%. Each checkpoint multiplies what remains. Independent misses are stipulated; these are not measured checklist effects.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? Real-world applicability and the connection to the book remain unverified.
